product_name: UGREEN SD Memory Card Reader Portable USB 3.0 Dual Slot Flash Adapter Hub for TF, SD, Micro SD, SDXC, SDHC, MMC, RS-MMC, Micro SDXC, Micro SDHC, UHS-I for Mac, Windows, Linux, Chrome, PC, Laptop
description: 5Gbps Super Speed: With USB 3.0 standard protocol, UGREEN USB card reader allows you to transfer HD movies or large files in just seconds. Read With Ease: Equipped with the powerful chip, UGREEN SD card reader could run your SD/SDHC/SDXC//MMC/RS-MMC/Micro SD/Micro SDXC/Micro SDHC/UHS-I memory cards smoothly. The SD card adapter also supports up to 2TB card capacity. Simultaneous Working: UGREEN micro SD card adapter is able to read and write on two cards at the same time, keeping you away from the hassle of constant unplugging and replugging. Broad Compatibility: Just plug and play. The tf card adaptor provides broad compatibility for Windows 11/10/8.1/8/7/XP/Vista, Mac OS, Linux, Chrome OS, etc. Portable & Anti-Lost Design: The portable slim size of the mini USB to SD card reader makes it easy to slip into your travel bag. An anti-lost keychain allows you to attach it to your key ring, or bag via a lanyard strap, easy to carry around.
